revenue_scope: Worldwide ILUVIEN product revenue, net (ILUVIEN is the only commercial product through Q1 2023). Through 2021Q1 and from 2021Q3 the 'Net revenue' line equals product revenue; 2021Q2 uses the 'Product revenue, net' line and excludes 11,048 thousand of license revenue.
geography: Worldwide (U.S. plus international; the total line is the sum of the U.S. and International columns)

approval_evidence.quote: ILUVIEN FLUOCINOLONE ACETONIDE 0.19MG IMPLANT;INTRAVITREAL ... 09/26/2014 ORIG-1 Approval Type 3 - New Dosage Form

launch_evidence.quote: We began generating revenue from ILUVIEN in the second quarter of 2013

series_start_reason: First quarter with ILUVIEN revenue: the company began generating revenue from ILUVIEN in the second quarter of 2013 (Q1 2013 nil).
series_end_reason: On May 17, 2023 Alimera took the commercialization rights to YUTIQ (fluocinolone acetonide, a second product) under a product rights agreement with EyePoint Pharmaceuticals (Form 10-Q for June 30, 2023, which states the agreement date). From Q2 2023 the company total is no longer ILUVIEN-only, and later filings print only a combined 'ILUVIEN and YUTIQ' line (ANI Pharmaceuticals, after its 2024 acquisition of Alimera). The series therefore ends at 2023Q1.
notes: Scope is worldwide ILUVIEN product revenue, net, one scope for every row. Before the second quarter of 2021 the statement prints a single revenue line (no license revenue line appears in the 2013-2021Q1 filings), and from 2021Q3 the 'License revenue' line is nil, so 'Net revenue' equals 'Product revenue, net' in every quarter except 2021Q2, where the statement prints Product revenue, net 10,655 and License revenue 11,048 (Ocumension transaction) for Net revenue of 21,703; 2021Q2 and the derivation of 2021Q4 use the product line. The 10-Q/10-K segment tables print U.S. and International net revenue (for example the Q1 2024 10-Q prints both columns for Q1 2023), so a U.S.-only series from 2015Q1 exists but starts two years after the worldwide series (U.K. and Germany sales from 2013, U.S. from 2015) and is not used. The company's 10-Ks describe ILUVIEN as the only commercial product ('Our only commercial product is ILUVIEN', FY2014, FY2018 and FY2019 10-Ks). Values are thousands of USD recorded in millions. Restatements of prior-year columns (for example Q1 2018 printed as 9,802 in its own 10-Q and 9,630 in the Q1 2019 10-Q) are not spliced: each quarter's own filing is used. 2013 quarterly lines are printed as 'REVENUE' (the 2013 filings) and 'NET REVENUE' thereafter.
search_log: Listed Alimera Sciences (CIK 0001267602, data.sec.gov/submissions) 10-Q/10-K filings from 2013 on. Searched every table for an ILUVIEN-only or YUTIQ line; none is printed in the 2013-2023 Alimera tables. The U.S. and International columns of the segment tables combine ILUVIEN and any other product, so the company total line is used, justified by the 'only commercial product' statements.
Searched Alimera filings for ILUVIEN sales sentences with figures (2014-2019): none found; the revenue discussion gives no ILUVIEN-only figure.
2013-2018: own quarterly 10-Q and 10-K lines. Q4 quarters derived as full-year 10-K less nine-month figure from the Q3 10-Q.
2019-2022: own quarterly 10-Q income statements; Q1 2022 derived as six months less Q2 2022 (the Q1 2022 10-Q's income statement is not a table row in the source file). Q4 derived from 10-Ks.
2023Q1: prior-year column of the Q1 2024 10-Q (the Q1 2023 10-Q's income statement is not a table row in the source file).
2024 onward: ANI Pharmaceuticals (CIK 0001023024) prints only a combined 'ILUVIEN and YUTIQ' line, not used.
FDA: Drugs@FDA NDA 201923 lists 09/26/2014 ORIG-1 Approval (approval_evidence); first_approval_year 2014 is also the issuer's statement in the FY2014 10-K.

Scope re-check of 2021Q2: the Q2 2021 10-Q statement of operations prints PRODUCT REVENUE, NET 10,655 / LICENSE REVENUE 11,048 / NET REVENUE 21,703 for the three months. Read the statement of operations of every cited filing: no 'license revenue' text appears in any filing from the Q2 2013 10-Q through the Q1 2021 10-Q; LICENSE REVENUE is nil for Q3 2021 and all of 2022; the FY2021 10-K prints Product revenue, net 47,981 and License revenue 11,048. 2021Q2 changed to 10.655 and 2021Q4 re-derived from the product lines (47,981 less 34,022 = 13,959, unchanged).
